tools.description: Submit an inquiry about a product or order; forwarded to the Brazilian Bikinis team.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_price_list · Private data: get_company_info, get_buying_options · Public sink: get_price_list, create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_price_list · Private data: get_company_info, get_buying_options · Public sink: get_price_list, create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Brazilian Bikinis products by name, category, SKU or description." → after: "Search styles by name, base style or category. Style metadata only; prices come from get_price_list."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
